items.excerpt: Chronohaze homepage organized around about, current work, mathematics, photography, and music.
items.content: 起点 在时间的薄雾里，为复杂性寻找结构。 证明关心什么可以被确信；音乐与影像关心什么值得被记住。 这里收录两者之间仍在继续的工作。 爱丁堡大学数学 · 康奈尔 2025–26 交换 · 优化、形式化验证与机器检查证明 快捷入口 学术 公开版 CV 代表性工作 技术笔记 GitHub 联系我 AFFIZIEREN - HAZEZZ 00:00 / 00:00 准备音频… 去音乐页试听 THREE POINTS OF EVIDENCE 三个硬证据 Published in AFP 在 Isabelle/HOL 中形式化基数约束单调子模最大化的 classical greedy 与 verified stateful lazy-greedy。 AFP entry Current research 优化、network localization 与 structured nonconvexity；关注 dual collapse、structural scores 与 saddle certificates。 Research statement Formalization project Projected gradient descent 与可复用证明基础设施：projection geometry、gradient mapping、convex convergence 与 linear rates。 Project note TWO PRACTICES 两种身份，两种工作方式 ACADEMIC IDENTITY · FEIER LYU Mathematics Theorems、Isabelle/HOL 与 optimization notes：从机器检查证明到结构化非凸问题。 AFP theorem PGD formalization Technical notes CREATIVE IDENTITY · HAZEZZ Music & Image Performance、作曲与摄影系列；让舞台、声音和影像各自保留完整的叙事空间。 Music / Performance Photography / Moving Image Creative / Now Now Edinburgh · Ithaca · Chongqing —— 塑造这些工作的地方。近期在准备 bass / guitar performance videos、继续写新作品，并整理摄影与 moving-image archive。 近况更新 2026. 07 Performance videos 准备一组制作完成度更高的 bass / guitar performance videos，重点提升画面、音色、低频与整体制作质感。 Music production 继续推进新的写作、编曲与制作，把 riff、旋律、低频设计和叙事放在同一条 production line 中。 Photography archive 整理 Edinburgh、Ithaca 与 Chongqing 留下的摄影系列，以及 photography / moving image 的公开归档。

items.excerpt: A concise academic index: optimization, formal verification, OR for ML, and selected publications, formalizations, and technical notes.
items.content: Research Statement Selected Work Technical Notes Academic 学术 Feier Lyu （Fay Lyu） Optimization · Formal Verification · OR for ML 爱丁堡大学数学本科；2025–2026 年于康奈尔大学交换学习。主要关注优化理论、形式化验证，以及 OR for ML 中的结构化问题。目前最成熟的工作是发表于 Archive of Formal Proofs 的 Isabelle/HOL 形式化项目。 Research Statement Selected Work Technical Notes Academic Academic Feier Lyu (Fay Lyu) Optimization · Formal Verification · OR for ML BSc Mathematics, University of Edinburgh. Exchange student at Cornell University, 2025–2026. I work around optimization, formal verification, and structured problems in OR for ML. My most mature work is an Isabelle/HOL formalization published in the Archive of Formal Proofs. Research Statement Selected Work Technical Notes SELECTED ACADEMIC WORK 代表性学术工作 01 Greedy Algorithms for Cardinality-Constrained Submodular Maximization 正式发表于 AFP（2026）：对基数约束下的单调子模最大化，形式化 classical greedy algorithm 与 verified stateful lazy-greedy variant。发表后扩展：当前仓库还进一步发展 StochasticGreedy theorem line，包括 sampling、approximation packaging 与 oracle-cost accounting。 AFP entry DOI 02 First-Order Methods for Smooth Convex Optimization in Isabelle/HOL Formalization project · submitted to AFP · awaiting review. Repository Project note 03 TTGDA and Second-Order Tracking Exploratory technical note · value-function viewpoint and second-order tracking. Technical note 04 Duality under Invariance Ongoing research note · dual collapse, structural scores, and saddle certificates. Post-publication extension: the current repository additionally develops a stochastic-greedy line, including sampling, approximation packaging, and oracle-cost accounting.
